proposal.hypothesis: Skill-focused rewards and stochastic exploration may improve a recovery slice while damaging walking, impact response, Mission resumption, redirection, traversal, or stop. Include the exactly zero residual actor at Training step 0 as a frozen Program-equivalent Policy candidate, then compare it with every learned checkpoint only on deterministic, complete no-reset Mission evidence across both authored impact directions and plant profiles.
proposal.expectedEffect: Publish learned weights only if they improve the integrated Mission ranking. Otherwise restore the step-0 Policy, proving that the ML artifact remains executable and behavior-equivalent to the Program baseline while preserving all learned checkpoints as negative research evidence for diagnosis.
